title: Wave types and representations
design_rationale: Separate oscillation direction from graph shape before interpreting longitudinal representations.
concepts_taught: Compare oscillation direction with wave travel direction.
Identify compressions and rarefactions in longitudinal waves.
Interpret displacement-distance and displacement-time graphs without treating them as literal paths.
Translate longitudinal-wave particle patterns into graphical representations.

next_module_can_assume: Compare oscillation direction with wave travel direction.

Interpret displacement-distance and displacement-time graphs without treating them as literal paths.
Translate longitudinal-wave particle patterns into graphical representations.
next_module_must_not_assume: Use intensity as power transferred per unit area.
